settings.name: JDBC URL
settings.description: The JDBC URL of the Identity Object Model database holding the agent instance registry, the same one device-enrolment's IDM_DATABASE_URL names, credentials included; a PingFederate data store replaces it (plan item PR-3) (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.registry.InstanceRegistryDataSource, shown as "Agent Instance Registry")

when_wrong.detail: Wrong or unreachable: every lookup fails and the issuance is refused. Another database: every lookup resolves to an unknown instance

settings.name: User verification max age (seconds)
settings.description: How recent the owner's user verification must be for uv_fresh to be true; it must match the enrolment service's UV_MAX_AGE_SECONDS, or the two disagree about when an agent stops (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.registry.InstanceRegistryDataSource, shown as "Agent Instance Registry")

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: 300, with a warning

settings.name: instance_id
settings.description: The data source's filter field: an access token mapping supplies the attestation's agent_id here (instance_id=${agent_id}) (plugin com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.registry.InstanceRegistryDataSource, shown as "Agent Instance Registry")

when_wrong.detail: Mapped to anything but the agent_id: every lookup resolves to an unknown instance, and a criterion on instance_active refuses the token
